entities.name: Crixizix
entities.description: A female goblin of the Izzet League, augmented by Zomaj Hauc, later promoted to Master Engineer.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild to which Crixizix belongs.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: Izzet magelord who augmented Crix and tried to control dragons; defeated.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet parun and guildmaster who promoted Crix.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Owner of the lokopede Crix traveled on.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Helped Crix; she saved him from the Cauldron explosion.

entities.name: Pivlic
entities.description: Helped Crix, later gravely wounded and healed by her.

entities.name: Utvara
entities.description: Location Crix traveled to, later ravaged by nephilim.

entities.name: The Cauldron
entities.description: Place where Crix delivered her message; it exploded.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Creatures that ravaged Utvara and fought Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Dissension
entities.description: The events during which Niv-Mizzet fought the nephilim.

events.summary: Zomaj Hauc augments Crix, turning her into a super-intelligent Izzet engineer.
events.quote: she was radically transformed through augmentation experiments conducted by her magelord

events.summary: Crix carries a covert mission for Hauc to control dragons, without Niv-Mizzet knowing.
events.quote: without the Izzet parun and guildmaster, Niv-Mizzet knowing this

events.summary: Crix becomes lost when Gruul attack Teysa Karlov's lokopede, then reaches the Cauldron with help from Vor Golozar, Agrus Kos and Pivlic.
events.quote: she was able to reach the Cauldron and deliver her message

events.summary: Crix defies Hauc and saves Agrus Kos from the Cauldron explosion.
events.quote: Crix defied her master and tried to stop him.

events.summary: After Hauc's defeat, Niv-Mizzet promotes Crix to Master Engineer.
events.quote: she was promoted by Niv-Mizzet to the rank of Master Engineer

events.summary: During the Dissension Crix witnesses Niv-Mizzet fight the nephilim and helps Utvara, healing Pivlic.
events.quote: She helped the citizens of nephilim-ravaged Utvara
